name: Magna Carta’s negotiated limits on royal power
description: English barons and King John agreed a charter that addressed grievances and recognized specified liberties and legal procedures.

date.basis: The cited account dates the episode; this is not a claim of global priority.

events.statement: King John agreed the charter at Runnymede in June 1215.
events.scope: The charter was annulled in 1215 and reissued in altered form; it did not establish universal suffrage or modern rights for all people.
